story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price LAURUSLABS to move about ±6.8%, roughly 2,341 to 2,683. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 57% of the time.
Options are cheap compared with how much LAURUSLABS has actually been moving: they price 28.9% a year while the last month realised 50.9%.
LAURUSLABS has actually been moving about 3.20% a day this past month: very high for it against the past year.
LAURUSLABS futures trade 6.4 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 2.9% a year, within its usual range for the past year.

iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 28.9%: 44th percentile of 1 year, 16th of all days since 2021-10-29.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much LAURUSLABS has actually been moving: they price 28.9% a year while the last month realised 50.9%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -22.0 vol points, 2nd percentile of the past year. Since 2021-10-29, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 66% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Longer-dated options on LAURUSLABS cost more than near ones: the normal, calm shape.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap -0.3 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for LAURUSLABS: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal -0.34 vol pts (front month), 71st percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.analyst: RV21 50.9% (97th percentile of the past year), RV5 29.9%, RV63 37.7%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 36th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 2,600 (+3.8% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 2,300 (-8.2%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.68; all-expiry OI PCR at the 67th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +87,125, puts +262,650 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: LAURUSLABS futures trade 6.4 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 2.9% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +6.4, annualised carry 2.9% (15th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.1%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long unwinding, Long build-up, Short covering, Short covering, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.
